info.name: GitHub Update Pre-receive Hook Enforcement for an Organization

params.name: org
params.description: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: pre_receive_hook_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the pre-receive hook.

items.docs: For pre-receive hooks which are allowed to be configured at the org level, you can set `enforcement` and `allow_downstream_configuration`

info.name: GitHub Remove Pre-receive Hook Enforcement for an Organization

params.name: org
params.description: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: pre_receive_hook_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the pre-receive hook.

items.docs: Removes any overrides for this hook at the org level for this org.

info.name: GitHub Update Pre-receive Hook Enforcement for Repository

params.name: owner
params.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: repo
params.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: pre_receive_hook_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the pre-receive hook.

items.docs: For pre-receive hooks which are allowed to be configured at the repo level, you can set `enforcement`

info.name: GitHub Remove Pre-receive Hook Enforcement for Repository

params.name: owner
params.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: repo
params.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: pre_receive_hook_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the pre-receive hook.

items.docs:
Deletes any overridden enforcement on this repository for the specified hook.

Responds with effective values inherited from owner and/or global level.
